title: New Apple TV 4K to have upgraded Siri Remote, per leak - 9to5Mac
summary: Mark Gurman has previously reported that the forthcoming hardware refresh would come with “possibly a tweaked Apple TV remote.” The discovery of this next generation of Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 suggests a new remote is indeed coming this fall.
